subject: The one mistake that ruins 87% of user results
preview_text: I discovered why most people miss winning picks. It's not the AI. It's this one simple oversight.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. We tracked the data from thousands of predictions, and there's a clear line between the users who consistently win and those who don't. It has nothing to do with the horses. It's a tiny, almost invisible mistake you're probably making right now.

The #1 mistake? Ignoring the Confidence Score. People see the AI's top pick and just bet. They skip the score. That number isn't decoration. It's the AI's calculated certainty based on jockey form, track conditions, weight—everything. A 92% score vs. a 65% score is the difference between a sure thing and a coin flip. Missing it is like having a weather forecast and only looking at the picture.

Here's the fix: Open any racecard. Before you even look at the horse names, find the Confidence Score. That's your true north. The AI does the heavy lifting, but that score is your final gut check. It separates emotional punting from calculated winning. Premium users get these scores for every single race, globally, in real-time.

Open the app right now. Pick a race. Look at the Confidence Score first. See how it changes your read on the entire card. P.S. The users who check this score have a 3x higher win rate. Don't be in the 87%.
